summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.95. Confirmed account takeover for c.aydin@aegean.edu. The account's normal baseline is two devices (dev-ca-laptop from AS-AEGEAN-EDU Manisa daytime, dev-ca-phone from Turkcell Manisa evenings). On 2026-10-08, an unknown device (dev-unk-7f3a) from 192.0.2.61 (AS60068 Datacamp Limited, Frankfurt, DE) performed 6 consecutive portal failures (22:41–22:44), then an MFA-approved portal login (22:46:12), followed by successful mail/SIS/portal access from Frankfurt (22:47–23:11). Within this same intrusion window, a mail forwarding rule was created sending mail to c.aydin.ogr@proton.me via OWA (22:49:02) — a classic ATO persistence/exfiltration signal. Geography, device, auth pattern, and mail-rule activity all deviate from baseline and indicate confirmed compromise.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
